Here is a summary of our May 5 client meeting. We discussed the requirements for the new project, agreed on the project timeline and key milestones, and reviewed the initial design concepts and your feedback.

Next steps: I will update the project plan based on your feedback, and David will coordinate with the development team to begin the initial phase. The next meeting is scheduled for 2024-06-01.

I've attached the meeting minutes for your reference.

Regards,
Emma Johnson
